title: Two Cups of Coffee
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary: Most Christians do not know or they mistreat the Holy Spirit. In part 1 of the Introduction to the Holy Spirit series, Pastor Antwan looks at who the Holy Spirit is and what He does.
quotes: He doesn't want to be used. He wants to be known.
The Trinity is 1 What (being) and 3 Whos (person).
Every single thing in your life changes when you get to know the Holy Spirit.
